sentences.text:
Author: S.K. Mishra Bench: S.K. Mishra  Office Notes,
 reports, orders  or proceedings SL.
 Date or directions COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS No  and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  13.02.2023 WPMS No. 334 of 2023  Hon'ble S.K. Mishra, J.
Mr. Shakti Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners.
Mr. T.S. Phartiyal, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.

Let the Short Counter Affidavit be filed within three weeks, on the question of maintainability of the writ application, in view of the Section 24 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 read with the ratio laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Indore Development Authority vs. Manoharlal (2020) 8 SCC 129.
